title: Turning
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Mark the front of the room clearly. Turn slowly and say where you face after each turn.

skills.key_step: The child names left and right turns and says where a half turn and a full turn end.
steps: Turn the way you are told.
contexts: a dance at a school event
a game of follow the leader

board.do: Face the board. Make a half turn.

misconceptions.ask: You face the board and make a half turn. Where do you face?
misconceptions.repair: Face the board, turn slowly and stop when you see the back wall.

misconceptions.ask: You face the board and make a full turn. Where do you face?
misconceptions.repair: Turn all the way round until you see the board again.

misconceptions.ask: Turn to your left. Which shoulder goes back?
misconceptions.repair: Hold up the left hand in an L shape before turning.

misconceptions.ask: You make two half turns. Where do you face?
misconceptions.repair: Make one half turn, say where you face, then another.

checks.question: Where do you face after a full turn?
Where do you face after a half turn from the front?
